title: Verification Holdback and the Seller's FBN Case History: Warehouse Loss
content:
*Desk training note, Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) warehouse-loss approvals.*

The verification holdback is the holdback share of 20% (0.2) of the units claimed, rounded down to a whole unit, for a seller with at least the denied-case trigger of 2 FBN reimbursement cases denied among the cases opened inside the case-history span of 12 months; it is waived (0 units) for a seller with no denied reimbursement case and at least the approved-case trigger of 3 approved FBN reimbursement cases among the cases opened inside that span. For every other seller the holdback is not altered by this note.

A case is opened inside the 12-month case-history span when fewer than 12 whole months have passed from its opening to the handling date, a whole month passing on the same day number of a later month. The cases counted are all of the seller's FBN reimbursement cases, of every loss kind, by their status: denied or approved.

## Questions and answers

**A seller has 2 denied and 5 approved cases opened in the last 12 months. What holdback applies?** 20% of the units claimed, rounded down: 2 denials reach the trigger of 2, whatever the approvals.

**A seller has 0 denied and 3 approved cases in the span. What holdback applies?** None: 0 units.

**A seller has 1 denied and 4 approved cases.** Neither description fits: the holdback is not altered by this note.

**A seller has 0 denied and 2 approved cases.** Neither description fits.

**Do cases opened 13 months ago count?** No; 12 or more whole months have passed.

## Rounding (hypothetical claims, 2 or more denials)

| Units claimed | 20% before rounding | Holdback |
|---|---|---|
| 24 | 4.8 | 4 units |
| 10 | 2.0 | 2 units |
| 4 | 0.8 | 0 units |
